summary: Full backend + frontend testing of QR Asset Desk. 17/17 pytest backend tests passed. Playwright UI flows validated: admin login, dashboard, assets CRUD + search + filter, asset detail with QR image, public asset page (/a/:qr_token), locked-asset report form, SOL-000010 creation (correlative >=7), public tracking page, admin request status update, users nav visible for admin, and USUARIO role correctly hides Usuarios nav, create-asset button and update-status-button.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py at ~620 lines is nearing the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting into auth/users/assets/requests/public modules for maintainability.
No brute-force lockout implemented on /api/auth/login (playbook mentions 5-attempt lockout). Not part of the stated feature set but flagged.
seed() will not add missing demo assets if the collection has any documents (guard 'count>0 return'); acceptable but slightly brittle.
list_assets/list_requests use to_list(1000) with no pagination; fine for MVP but should paginate for scale.
